title: Boolean derivative
statement: For a natural number $n$, a function $f: br_2^n	o br_2$, and $y\in br_2^n$, the Boolean derivative of $f$ in direction $y$ is the function sending each $x\in br_2^n$ to $f(x)+f(x+y)$, with addition in $ br_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the Boolean cube $ br_2^n$ to $ br_2$
